title: 1915 恰納卡萊大橋~1915 Canakkale Bridge
focus: 首座主跨超過 2,000 m 的懸索橋：垂跨比、1,960 MPa 鋼絲、隔震式沉箱基礎與雙箱梁抗風~The first suspension span beyond 2,000 m: sag ratio, 1,960 MPa wire, isolated caisson foundations and twin-box wind resistance
summary: 1915 恰納卡萊大橋以 2,023 m 主跨橫跨達達尼爾海峽，2022 年通車，鋼塔高 318 m。本課從垂跨比與塔高的取捨出發，計算 1,960 MPa 級平行鋼絲主纜的斷面，說明在地震帶海床上以乾塢預製、拖航沉放的沉箱作為隔震式基礎，再處理索鞍預偏、87 個橋面節塊吊裝、雙箱梁風洞試驗、吊索力量測、鋼橋面疲勞與伸縮縫交接。~The 1915 Çanakkale Bridge crosses the Dardanelles with a 2,023 m main span and 318 m steel towers, opening in 2022. The course starts from the trade-off between sag ratio and tower height, sizes a parallel-wire cable of 1,960 MPa class wire, explains caissons built in dry dock, towed and set on a seismic seabed as an isolated foundation, then covers saddle presetting, lifting 87 deck blocks, twin-box wind-tunnel testing, hanger-force measurement, steel-deck fatigue and expansion-joint handover.

units.anchor: 垂跨比與 318 m 塔高~Sag ratio and 318 m towers
units.title: 主跨、垂跨比與塔高的取捨~Main span, sag ratio and tower height
units.mechanism: 懸索橋的主纜幾何由三個數字綁在一起：主跨、垂度與航道淨空。業主公開的配置為 770 m + 2,023 m + 770 m，鋼塔高 318 m（含頂部砲彈造型裝飾為 334 m），垂直航行淨空 70 m、水平航行淨空 1,600 m。垂度越大，主纜水平張力越小、鋼絲用量越省，但塔必須更高、塔與基礎承受更大的彎矩與風載；垂度越小則塔較矮但主纜更重。2,023 m 這個數字具有建國百年的象徵意義，工程團隊需要在此限制下用垂跨比平衡塔高與纜索張力。~The main-cable geometry of a suspension bridge ties three numbers together: main span, sag and navigation clearance. The owner's published layout is 770 m + 2,023 m + 770 m, with 318 m steel towers (334 m including the shell-shaped finials), 70 m vertical and 1,600 m horizontal navigation clearance. More sag lowers horizontal cable tension and saves wire, but the towers must be taller and the towers and foundations carry larger moments and wind loads; less sag gives shorter towers but heavier cables. The 2,023 m figure carries the symbolism of the Republic's centenary, so the team had to balance tower height and cable tension through the sag ratio within that constraint.
units.model: 塔頂高程 ≈ 跨中橋面高程 + 纜梁最小間距 + 垂度。取橋面 72.8 m、間距 6 m、垂跨比 1/8.5：f = 2,023/8.5 = 238.0 m，塔高約 72.8 + 6 + 238 ≈ 317 m；若改為 1/10，f = 202.3 m，塔高約 281 m，但水平張力 H ∝ 1/n 增加 18%。間距與垂跨比為教學假設。~Tower-top level ≈ mid-span deck level + minimum cable-to-girder gap + sag. With the deck at 72.8 m, a 6 m gap and sag ratio 1/8.5: f = 2,023/8.5 = 238.0 m and the tower is about 72.8 + 6 + 238 ≈ 317 m; at 1/10, f = 202.3 m and the tower is about 281 m, but horizontal tension H ∝ 1/n rises 18%. Gap and sag ratio are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以參數研究比較不同垂跨比下的主纜鋼量、塔鋼量、基礎反力與塔頂風致位移，畫出總造價或總鋼量對垂跨比的曲線；配置定案後，以航道主管機關核准的淨空包絡線檢查最不利溫度與活載下的橋面最低點。~Run a parametric study comparing cable steel, tower steel, foundation reactions and wind-induced tower-top displacement for several sag ratios, plotting total cost or steel against sag ratio; once fixed, check the lowest deck point under the worst temperature and live load against the clearance envelope approved by the navigation authority.
units.failure: 若只以主纜鋼量最省選擇大垂度，塔高與塔底彎矩可能增加到基礎難以承受，也延長塔施工與高空作業時間；反之垂度過小，主纜張力與錨碇規模暴增，錨碇基礎可能成為控制造價的瓶頸。~Choosing a large sag only to minimise cable steel can raise tower height and base moment beyond what the foundations can comfortably take and lengthen high-level tower work; too little sag inflates cable tension and anchorage size, making anchorage foundations the cost bottleneck.
units.misconception: 塔越高越好，因為主纜張力一定會跟著變小，整座橋就越省。~Taller towers are always better because lower cable tension makes the whole bridge cheaper.
units.practice: 總體配置階段應保存垂跨比比較表與航道淨空核准文件，並把選定的垂跨比、塔高與溫度假設寫入設計基準書，日後任何線形變更都要回到此基準重新檢核淨空與張力。~At the general-arrangement stage keep the sag-ratio comparison table and the navigation clearance approval, and write the chosen sag ratio, tower height and temperature assumptions into the design basis, so any later profile change is re-checked against clearance and tension from that baseline.

units.anchor: 45 m 寬鋼箱梁~45 m wide steel deck
units.title: 寬幅雙箱梁的抗風策略~Wind strategy for a wide twin-box deck
units.mechanism: 主跨超過 2 km 時，扭轉頻率更低，單一流線形箱梁難以單靠形狀把顫振風速推得夠高。本橋橋面寬約 45 m、最大梁深約 3.5 m，提供雙向六車道與兩側維修走道，鋼箱以約 24 m 間距的橫梁連接，形成中央開口的雙箱斷面。中央開口讓上下表面的壓力在開口處部分平衡，降低驅動扭轉的氣動力矩，是近年超長跨懸索橋常用的顫振對策；代價是橫梁與開口邊緣更容易引發渦流振動，需要導流板或其他細部處理。~Beyond 2 km the torsional frequency falls further and a single streamlined box can hardly push the flutter speed high enough by shape alone. This deck is about 45 m wide and up to about 3.5 m deep, carrying six traffic lanes and maintenance walkways, with steel boxes linked by cross-beams at about 24 m spacing to form a twin-box section with a central opening. The opening partly equalises pressure between upper and lower surfaces, reducing the aerodynamic moment that drives torsion, a common flutter measure on recent super-long suspension spans; the price is that cross-beams and opening edges are more prone to vortex-induced vibration, needing guide vanes or other detailing.
units.model: 顫振臨界折減風速 V_r = U_F/(f_T·B)。取 f_T = 0.12 Hz、B = 45 m：若斷面 V_r = 13，U_F = 13×0.12×45 ≈ 70 m/s；中央開口若把 V_r 提高到 15，U_F ≈ 81 m/s，提升約 15%。數值為教學假設。~Critical reduced flutter velocity V_r = U_F/(f_T·B). With f_T = 0.12 Hz and B = 45 m: a section with V_r = 13 gives U_F = 13×0.12×45 ≈ 70 m/s; if the central opening raises V_r to 15, U_F ≈ 81 m/s, about 15% higher. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 比較封閉單箱與不同開口寬度的斷面模型，量測氣動導數與渦振鎖定風速範圍；選定斷面後檢查各風攻角的顫振臨界風速與渦振振幅，並以使用性準則（例如行車舒適的加速度限值）評估渦振。~Compare section models of a closed single box and several opening widths, measuring aerodynamic derivatives and vortex lock-in ranges; for the chosen section check flutter onset at each angle of attack and vortex amplitudes against serviceability criteria such as driver-comfort acceleration limits.
units.failure: 開口斷面若未處理橫梁與欄杆細部，中低風速時可能出現持續的豎向渦振，雖不危及強度卻造成用路人不適與疲勞循環；大貝爾特東橋通車後即因箱梁渦振加裝導流板。~If cross-beams and railings on a twin-box section are not detailed, persistent vertical vortex vibration can appear at moderate wind speeds, harmless to strength but uncomfortable for drivers and a source of fatigue cycles; the Great Belt East Bridge had guide vanes added after opening for box-girder vortex vibration.
units.misconception: 橋面中間開口會削弱橋梁，因此對抗風一定不利。~An opening in the middle of the deck weakens the bridge and must be bad for wind resistance.
units.practice: 欄杆、隔音牆、維修車軌道等附屬物的形狀與透空率必須在風洞試驗前凍結；施工期間任何附屬物變更都須回送風工程師確認，並在竣工圖中標明經試驗的斷面版本。~Freeze the shape and porosity of railings, screens and gantry rails before wind-tunnel testing; any change during construction goes back to the wind engineer, and the as-built drawings must identify the tested section version.

units.anchor: 1,960 MPa 平行鋼絲~1,960 MPa parallel wire
units.title: 1,960 MPa 鋼絲的主纜斷面~Main-cable section with 1,960 MPa wire
units.mechanism: 業主刊物列出主纜鋼絲抗拉強度為 1,960 MPa 級，資料庫記載每條主纜在主跨由 144 股、每股 127 根 5.75 mm 鋼絲組成（邊跨增至 148 股以承受較大張力）。相較明石海峽大橋的約 1,770 MPa 級鋼絲，強度提高約 11%，同一張力所需鋼絲面積與自重都下降，而自重下降又回饋減少張力，這是主跨能超過 2 km 的關鍵之一。代價是鋼絲對缺口、氫脆與疲勞更敏感，對鍍層、製造品管與防蝕的要求同步提高。~The owner's publication gives the cable wire strength as the 1,960 MPa class, and a structures database records each main cable in the main span as 144 strands of 127 wires of 5.75 mm (rising to 148 strands in the side spans to carry their higher tension). Compared with the roughly 1,770 MPa class wire of Akashi Kaikyo this is about 11% stronger, so the wire area and self-weight for a given tension fall, and the lower self-weight feeds back into lower tension, one of the keys to exceeding 2 km. The price is greater sensitivity to notches, hydrogen embrittlement and fatigue, raising demands on coating, manufacturing control and corrosion protection.
units.model: 單絲面積 π/4×5.75² = 25.97 mm²，144×127 = 18,288 根，A ≈ 474,900 mm²，破斷力 ≈ 474,900×1,960 ≈ 931 MN。若空隙率 20%，主纜外徑 ≈ √(4×0.594/π) ≈ 0.87 m；鋼絲自重 0.4749×7,850 ≈ 3.73 t/m。改用 1,770 MPa 鋼絲提供同破斷力需面積多約 10.7%。空隙率為教學假設。~Wire area π/4×5.75² = 25.97 mm², with 144×127 = 18,288 wires, A ≈ 474,900 mm² and breaking force ≈ 474,900×1,960 ≈ 931 MN. With a 20% void ratio the cable diameter is ≈ √(4×0.594/π) ≈ 0.87 m; wire self-weight is 0.4749×7,850 ≈ 3.73 t/m. Supplying the same force with 1,770 MPa wire needs about 10.7% more area. The void ratio is a teaching assumption.
units.verify: 鋼絲規格須涵蓋抗拉強度、0.2% 耐力、伸長率、扭轉與彎曲試驗、鍍層附著量與均勻性；每股完成後檢查長度標記與錨頭灌注，抽樣做錨頭拉拔與疲勞試驗；架設後以纜徑與周長量測核算空隙率是否在設計範圍。~The wire specification must cover tensile strength, 0.2% proof stress, elongation, torsion and bend tests, coating mass and uniformity; check length marks and socket filling on every strand, sample sockets for pull-out and fatigue tests, and after erection compute void ratio from measured diameter and circumference against the design range.
units.failure: 超高強度鋼絲若伸長率或扭轉性能不足，會在索鞍或索夾附近的局部彎曲處提早斷絲；鍍層不均或運輸刮傷則讓腐蝕坑成為疲勞與氫脆的起點，斷絲往往在多年後才在內部檢查中發現。~Ultra-high-strength wire with inadequate elongation or torsion performance can break early where it bends locally at saddles or cable bands; uneven coating or transport scratches make corrosion pits the starting point for fatigue and hydrogen embrittlement, and broken wires are often found only years later during internal inspection.
units.misconception: 只要鋼絲抗拉強度夠高，其他性能指標都不重要。~As long as tensile strength is high enough, the wire's other properties do not matter.
units.practice: 對 1,960 MPa 級鋼絲，採購應要求製程資格試驗、批次追溯與第三方見證，並把延性、扭轉與鍍層試驗的不合格處理流程寫清楚；運輸與牽引機具接觸面須加保護墊。~For 1,960 MPa class wire, procurement should require process qualification tests, batch traceability and third-party witnessing, with a written procedure for ductility, torsion or coating test failures; protect every contact surface of transport and hauling equipment with pads.

units.anchor: 隔震式沉箱基礎~Isolated caisson foundation
units.title: 地震帶上的重力式沉箱~Gravity caissons in a seismic zone
units.mechanism: 達達尼爾海峽位於北安那托利亞斷層系統附近的地震活躍區，主塔基礎必須在不可預期的地震中保護 318 m 鋼塔。業主刊物指出本橋採用「隔震式基礎」以提高耐震性；這類重力式沉箱放在整平的碎石墊層上而不以樁與岩盤固接，地震時若水平力超過墊層摩擦抗力，沉箱允許少量滑動，等於為傳入塔身的水平力設定上限。設計要同時檢核承載、沉陷、滑動位移與滑動後的殘餘傾斜。~The Dardanelles lie in an active seismic region near the North Anatolian Fault system, and the tower foundations must protect 318 m steel towers in unpredictable earthquakes. The owner's publication states that an isolated foundation was used to improve seismic resistance; such gravity caissons rest on a levelled gravel bed rather than being fixed to rock by piles, so if the horizontal force exceeds the bed's friction resistance in an earthquake the caisson may slide slightly, capping the horizontal force passed into the tower. Design must check bearing, settlement, sliding displacement and residual tilt after sliding together.
units.model: 滑動上限 H_max = μ·N'。取有效垂直力 N' = 2,000 MN、碎石墊層摩擦係數 μ = 0.6，H_max = 1,200 MN。若沉箱含附加水質量 M = 280,000 t、地表加速度 0.5 g，剛性需求 M·a = 280×10⁶×4.905 ≈ 1,373 MN > 1,200 MN，沉箱會滑動，傳入上部的力被限制在約 1,200 MN。數值為教學假設。~Sliding cap H_max = μ·N'. With effective vertical force N' = 2,000 MN and gravel-bed friction μ = 0.6, H_max = 1,200 MN. For a caisson with added-water mass M = 280,000 t and 0.5 g ground acceleration the rigid demand M·a = 280×10⁶×4.905 ≈ 1,373 MN > 1,200 MN, so the caisson slides and the force passed upward is limited to about 1,200 MN. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以非線性時間歷程分析輸入多組近斷層與遠域地震紀錄，求滑動位移、轉角與塔頂殘餘位移，與容許值比較；碎石墊層的摩擦係數以大型直剪或現地試驗確認，鋪設後以多音束測深檢查平整度。~Run nonlinear time-history analyses with several near-fault and far-field records to obtain sliding displacement, rotation and residual tower-top offset against allowable values; confirm gravel-bed friction by large direct-shear or field tests, and check bed flatness by multibeam survey after placement.
units.failure: 若墊層摩擦係數被高估，實際滑動門檻偏高，塔身承受比設計更大的地震力；若墊層不平或局部軟弱，沉箱沉放後可能產生初始傾斜，地震滑動時再放大殘餘傾斜，影響主纜幾何與伸縮縫。~Overestimating bed friction raises the real sliding threshold so the tower sees larger seismic forces than designed; an uneven or locally soft bed can give the caisson an initial tilt after placement that grows during seismic sliding, disturbing cable geometry and expansion joints.
units.misconception: 基礎在地震中滑動就代表設計失敗。~If a foundation slides in an earthquake, the design has failed.
units.practice: 墊層材料、級配、鋪設厚度與平整度允差應作為沉箱沉放前的停留點，由設計者與第三方驗證單位共同簽認；營運期應保存基礎座標與傾斜基準，以便地震後快速比對。~Gravel material, grading, thickness and flatness tolerance should be a hold point before caisson placement, signed jointly by the designer and the independent checker; in service keep foundation coordinate and tilt baselines for rapid post-earthquake comparison.

units.anchor: 乾塢預製與拖航~Dry-dock casting and tow
units.title: 沉箱乾塢預製、拖航與沉放~Caisson casting, towing and immersion
units.mechanism: 業主時間軸記載 2019 年 1 月沉箱由乾塢拖往濕塢，同年 4 月與 5 月分別完成歐洲側與亞洲側沉箱上的鋼塔基段安裝。這種流程讓大部分混凝土在乾塢或靠岸位置完成，再以拖船把漂浮沉箱拖到塔位、逐艙灌水沉放到預先整平的墊層上。漂浮期間沉箱必須有足夠穩性抵抗風浪傾覆，沉放時則要控制各艙水位使沉箱水平下降，最後就位誤差通常以公分計。~The owner's timeline records the caissons being towed from the dry dock to the wet dock in January 2019, with the steel shaft installation on the European and Asian caissons completed in April and May of that year. This sequence completes most concrete in the dry dock or alongside a quay, after which tugs tow the floating caisson to the tower site and it is ballasted compartment by compartment onto the levelled bed. Afloat, the caisson needs enough stability to resist capsizing in wind and waves; during immersion compartment water levels are controlled so it descends level, and final positioning error is usually measured in centimetres.
units.model: 吃水 d = W/(ρ_w·A_p)。設平面 70 m × 80 m、拖航重量 75,000 t：V = 75,000/1.025 ≈ 73,170 m³，d ≈ 13.1 m。穩心高 GM = KB + BM − KG，BM = I/V = (70³×80/12)/73,170 ≈ 31.3 m，KB ≈ 6.5 m，KG 取 15 m，GM ≈ 22.8 m > 0，穩定。數值為教學假設。~Draft d = W/(ρ_w·A_p). For a 70 m × 80 m plan and a 75,000 t towing weight: V = 75,000/1.025 ≈ 73,170 m³ and d ≈ 13.1 m. Metacentric height GM = KB + BM − KG, with BM = I/V = (70³×80/12)/73,170 ≈ 31.3 m, KB ≈ 6.5 m and KG taken as 15 m, gives GM ≈ 22.8 m > 0, stable. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 拖航前由海事檢驗單位核可穩性計算、拖航路線與氣象窗口；沉放過程以 GNSS、傾斜儀與各艙水位計即時監控，就位後以水下測量確認平面位置、高程與傾斜，與允差比較後才可灌注壓艙材料。~Before towing, a marine warranty surveyor approves stability calculations, tow route and weather window; during immersion monitor GNSS, inclinometers and compartment levels in real time, and after landing confirm position, level and tilt by underwater survey against tolerances before permanent ballast is placed.
units.failure: 各艙灌水不同步會讓沉箱傾斜，自由液面效應降低穩心高，嚴重時可能失穩；若在海流或風浪超過預報時強行沉放，沉箱可能偏離墊層或撞擊已鋪設的碎石，造成就位誤差與墊層損傷。~Unsynchronised ballasting tilts the caisson and free-surface effects reduce metacentric height, possibly to instability; forcing immersion when currents or waves exceed the forecast can push the caisson off the bed or scour the placed gravel, causing positioning error and bed damage.
units.misconception: 沉箱很重，所以漂浮時一定很穩定，不需要穩性計算。~A caisson is so heavy that it is always stable afloat and needs no stability check.
units.practice: 拖航與沉放須有書面的氣象與海況停止條件、各艙灌水順序表與緊急程序，並由海事保證檢驗人員簽發許可；每一階段的實測吃水與傾斜要與計算值比對並記錄。~Towing and immersion need written weather and sea-state stop criteria, a compartment ballasting table and emergency procedures, with approval issued by the marine warranty surveyor; compare and log measured draft and tilt at every stage against calculation.

units.anchor: 索鞍預偏與 87 個節塊~Saddle preset and 87 blocks
units.title: 橋面節塊吊裝與索鞍預偏~Deck-block lifting and saddle presetting
units.mechanism: 業主刊物記載主跨以 87 個大小不一的橋面節塊吊起並連接到吊索，2021 年 11 月 13 日全部完成。節塊從跨中與塔邊依序吊裝時，主跨主纜荷重增加比邊跨快，若索鞍固定在塔頂，主纜不平衡水平力會把塔頂拉向主跨。因此大型懸索橋常把索鞍預先往邊跨方向偏移，隨橋面荷重增加分階段以千斤頂推回，讓塔身彎矩維持在容許範圍；節塊之間則暫時以鉸接連接，待線形接近完工狀態後再焊接封閉。~The owner's publication records 87 deck blocks of various sizes lifted and connected to the hangers in the main span, all completed on 13 November 2021. As blocks are lifted from mid-span and from the towers, load on the main-span cable grows faster than on the side spans; with saddles fixed on the towers, the unbalanced horizontal force would pull the tower tops toward the main span. Large suspension bridges therefore often preset saddles toward the side spans and jack them back in stages as deck load increases, keeping tower moments within limits, while blocks are temporarily hinged together and only welded closed once the profile approaches its final state.
units.model: 邊跨主纜因張力增量而伸長 ΔL = ΔT·L_s/(E·A)。取 ΔT = 230 MN、L_s = 850 m、E = 200 GPa、A = 0.4749 m²：ΔL = 230×10⁶×850/(2×10¹¹×0.4749) ≈ 2.06 m。這是塔頂若不調整可能被拉動的量級，索鞍預偏量與分次頂推量依此規劃。數值為教學假設。~The side-span cable stretches by ΔL = ΔT·L_s/(E·A) as tension grows. With ΔT = 230 MN, L_s = 850 m, E = 200 GPa and A = 0.4749 m²: ΔL = 230×10⁶×850/(2×10¹¹×0.4749) ≈ 2.06 m. This is the order of tower-top movement if nothing is adjusted, and saddle preset and staged jacking are planned from it. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 每吊裝一批節塊後量測塔頂位移、索鞍相對位置、主纜垂度與節塊高程，與施工階段分析預測比較；塔底應力或塔頂偏位接近門檻時，依程序頂推索鞍，並記錄千斤頂力、行程與溫度。~After each batch of blocks, measure tower-top displacement, saddle position, cable sag and block levels against the construction-stage analysis; when tower-base stress or tower-top offset nears its trigger, jack the saddles per procedure, logging jack force, stroke and temperature.
units.failure: 若索鞍頂推落後於吊裝進度，塔頂偏位與塔底彎矩可能超過鋼塔局部挫屈或基礎容許值；節塊過早焊接封閉，則在後續荷重下接頭承受強迫彎矩而開裂。~If saddle jacking lags behind lifting, tower-top offset and base moment may exceed steel-tower local buckling or foundation limits; welding blocks closed too early forces bending into the joints under later loads and can crack them.
units.misconception: 索鞍在施工期間固定不動，主纜就會自然平衡。~Saddles stay fixed during construction and the cables balance themselves.
units.practice: 施工階段分析須列出每一吊裝階段的塔頂容許偏位、索鞍頂推觸發值與節塊焊接時機，形成可在現場執行的控制表；任何吊裝順序變更都要重算並由設計者核准。~The construction-stage analysis must list, for each lifting stage, the allowable tower-top offset, the saddle-jacking trigger and the block-welding window as a control table the site can follow; any change to lifting sequence must be recomputed and approved by the designer.

units.anchor: 斷面模型雷諾數~Section-model Reynolds number
units.title: 風洞試驗的相似性與雷諾數效應~Similarity and Reynolds effects in wind-tunnel tests
units.mechanism: 公開資料顯示本橋的風洞試驗由加拿大邊界層風洞實驗室與丹麥 FORCE Technology 參與。斷面模型能依 Froude 或折減風速相似重現顫振與渦振，但模型雷諾數遠低於實橋，對圓角、導流板與欄杆等會影響流動分離位置的細部特別敏感。因此試驗計畫常以不同風速重複試驗觀察趨勢，必要時用加大比例的局部模型或計算流體力學輔助判讀，並以多個實驗室交叉比對結果。~Public records show the bridge's wind-tunnel testing involved the Boundary Layer Wind Tunnel Laboratory in Canada and FORCE Technology in Denmark. Section models can reproduce flutter and vortex shedding through Froude or reduced-velocity similarity, but their Reynolds number is far below full scale and they are particularly sensitive to rounded corners, guide vanes and railings that set where flow separates. Test programmes therefore repeat runs at several speeds to watch trends, use larger-scale partial models or computational fluid dynamics where needed, and cross-check results between laboratories.
units.model: 雷諾數 Re = U·B/ν。實橋 U = 70 m/s、B = 45 m、ν = 1.5×10⁻⁵ m²/s：Re ≈ 2.1×10⁸；1:50 模型 B = 0.9 m、試驗風速 10 m/s：Re ≈ 6.0×10⁵，相差約 350 倍。若模型提高到 1:25 且風速 15 m/s，Re ≈ 1.8×10⁶，差距縮為約 117 倍。數值為教學假設。~Reynolds number Re = U·B/ν. Full scale with U = 70 m/s, B = 45 m and ν = 1.5×10⁻⁵ m²/s gives Re ≈ 2.1×10⁸; a 1:50 model with B = 0.9 m at 10 m/s gives Re ≈ 6.0×10⁵, about 350 times smaller. A 1:25 model at 15 m/s gives Re ≈ 1.8×10⁶, narrowing the gap to about 117 times. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 比較不同風速與不同比例模型下的氣動係數與渦振振幅，確認結果是否隨雷諾數改變；兩個實驗室對相同斷面的顫振臨界風速差異應在事先約定的範圍內，否則須找出原因（模型阻尼、紊流、支撐剛度）。~Compare aerodynamic coefficients and vortex amplitudes across speeds and model scales to see whether results drift with Reynolds number; the flutter onset found by two laboratories for the same section should agree within a pre-agreed band, otherwise identify the cause (model damping, turbulence, support stiffness).
units.failure: 若圓角或欄杆細部對雷諾數敏感而未察覺，模型可能顯示沒有渦振，但實橋在某風速範圍出現明顯振動；單一實驗室的系統誤差也可能讓顫振裕度被高估。~If a rounded corner or railing detail is Reynolds-sensitive and this goes unnoticed, the model may show no vortex vibration while the real deck vibrates noticeably in some wind range; a single laboratory's systematic error can also overstate flutter margin.
units.misconception: 模型做得越精細，雷諾數差異就不重要。~If the model is detailed enough, the Reynolds-number mismatch does not matter.
units.practice: 風洞合約應要求提交模型頻率與阻尼校核、紊流特性、雷諾數敏感度試驗與原始資料；設計者應指定由獨立驗證單位複核關鍵試驗，並把未能以模型確認的細部列入完工後的監測重點。~Wind-tunnel contracts should require model frequency and damping calibration, turbulence characteristics, Reynolds-sensitivity runs and raw data; the designer should have the independent checker review key tests and list details the model could not confirm as monitoring priorities after completion.

units.anchor: 吊索振動法張力~Hanger tension by vibration
units.title: 以振動頻率驗證吊索力~Verifying hanger forces by vibration frequency
units.mechanism: 橋面節塊掛上吊索後，每根吊索的實際張力決定了荷重是否如設計般分配到主纜，也影響索夾滑移與局部疲勞。直接在每根吊索裝荷重計成本高，因此常用振動法：量測吊索自然頻率，由弦公式反算張力。較短或較粗的吊索彎曲勁度不可忽略，端部錨頭與索夾的邊界條件也會改變頻率，需以修正公式或有限元素模型校正，並以少數裝有荷重計或千斤頂的吊索作為標定。~Once deck blocks hang from the hangers, the actual force in each hanger shows whether load reaches the cables as designed, and it also affects cable-band slip and local fatigue. Fitting a load cell to every hanger is costly, so the vibration method is common: measure the hanger's natural frequencies and back-calculate tension from the string formula. Bending stiffness of short or stout hangers cannot be ignored and end sockets and cable bands change the boundary conditions, so a corrected formula or finite-element model is calibrated against a few hangers fitted with load cells or jacks.
units.model: 弦公式 T = 4·m·L²·f_n²/n²。取 m = 60 kg/m、L = 100 m、第一模態 f₁ = 0.9 Hz：T = 4×60×100²×0.9² ≈ 1.94 MN。頻率量測誤差 2% 會造成張力誤差約 1.02² − 1 ≈ 4%，因此頻率解析度與有效長度的判定都很關鍵。數值為教學假設。~String formula T = 4·m·L²·f_n²/n². With m = 60 kg/m, L = 100 m and first-mode f₁ = 0.9 Hz: T = 4×60×100²×0.9² ≈ 1.94 MN. A 2% frequency error gives a tension error of about 1.02² − 1 ≈ 4%, so frequency resolution and the effective length both matter. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在每根吊索上以加速度計記錄環境振動數分鐘，取多個模態頻率以線性回歸 f_n/n 與 n 的關係分離彎曲勁度影響；結果與施工階段分析的預測吊索力比較，偏差超過約定門檻（例如 ±10%）的吊索列入調整或複測清單。~Record ambient vibration on every hanger for several minutes with an accelerometer, use several modal frequencies and regress f_n/n against n to separate bending-stiffness effects; compare with forces predicted by the construction-stage analysis and put hangers deviating beyond an agreed threshold, such as ±10%, on an adjustment or re-test list.
units.failure: 若忽略彎曲勁度或錯用有效長度，短吊索的張力會被系統性高估或低估，導致錯誤調整；吊索力分配不均會讓個別索夾承受過大的下滑力，長期可能出現索夾滑移與防護層破損。~Ignoring bending stiffness or using the wrong effective length systematically misjudges short-hanger tension and leads to wrong adjustments; uneven hanger forces load individual cable bands with excessive sliding force, which over time can cause band slip and damage to the protection.
units.misconception: 只要量到吊索的一個頻率，就能精確算出張力。~One measured hanger frequency is enough to compute tension precisely.
units.practice: 吊索力量測要在溫度穩定、無施工荷重移動的時段進行，記錄溫度與當時的施工狀態；完工時的全橋吊索力表應納入交接文件，作為營運期每次檢測的比較基準。~Measure hanger forces when temperature is steady and no construction loads are moving, logging temperature and construction state; include the full set of completion hanger forces in the handover documents as the baseline for every later inspection.

units.anchor: 鋼橋面板肋焊道~Steel deck rib welds
units.title: 正交異性鋼橋面的疲勞細部~Fatigue details of the orthotropic steel deck
units.mechanism: 懸索橋的鋼箱梁頂板直接承受輪壓，縱肋與頂板、縱肋與橫隔板的焊接處在每次重車通過時都經歷局部應力循環。這類疲勞以局部彎曲為主，與整體主纜受力關係不大，因此主跨長度不會減輕它；交通量越大、重車比例越高，焊道累積的損傷越快。設計上可以加厚頂板、改善縱肋與橫隔板的切口形狀、規定全滲透或高熔深焊接，並在鋪面上選擇較高勁度的材料分散輪壓。~The top plate of a suspension bridge's steel box carries wheel loads directly, and the welds between ribs and deck plate and between ribs and diaphragms go through local stress cycles with every heavy vehicle. This fatigue is dominated by local bending and has little to do with global cable forces, so a long main span does nothing to relieve it; the more traffic and the higher the share of heavy trucks, the faster damage accumulates at the welds. Designers can thicken the deck plate, improve rib-to-diaphragm cut-out shapes, specify full or deep-penetration welds, and choose stiffer surfacing that spreads wheel loads.
units.model: 局部彎曲應力約與頂板厚度平方成反比：t 由 14 mm 增為 18 mm，應力比 (14/18)² ≈ 0.605。若 S–N 曲線斜率 m = 3，疲勞壽命比 = (1/0.605)³ ≈ 4.5 倍；即同樣交通下，加厚頂板可把焊道壽命延長約 4.5 倍。數值為教學假設。~Local bending stress is roughly inversely proportional to the square of deck-plate thickness: going from 14 mm to 18 mm gives a stress ratio of (14/18)² ≈ 0.605. With an S–N slope of m = 3, the fatigue-life ratio is (1/0.605)³ ≈ 4.5, so under the same traffic a thicker plate extends weld life by about 4.5 times. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 製造時以超音波或相位陣列檢查縱肋焊道熔深，抽樣切片確認；完工前在代表性位置貼應變計做載重車試驗，量測實際應力範圍與分析比較；營運期以目視、磁粉或渦流檢測定期檢查焊趾與切口。~During fabrication check rib-weld penetration by ultrasonic or phased-array testing with sample macro-sections; before opening, strain-gauge representative locations and run a test-truck programme to compare measured stress ranges with analysis; in service inspect weld toes and cut-outs periodically by visual, magnetic-particle or eddy-current testing.
units.failure: 縱肋與頂板焊根的疲勞裂縫可能向頂板內擴展而不易從箱內看見，最終造成鋪面開裂與滲水；橫隔板切口的裂縫則會延伸到腹板。這類問題在多座早期鋼箱梁橋已有案例，修補需封閉車道。~Fatigue cracks at the rib-to-deck weld root can grow into the deck plate without being visible from inside the box, eventually cracking the surfacing and letting water in; cracks at diaphragm cut-outs can run into the web. Many early steel-box bridges have had such problems, and repairs require lane closures.
units.misconception: 主跨越長，橋面承受的車輛荷重比例越小，所以鋼橋面不會疲勞。~The longer the span, the smaller the share of vehicle load, so the steel deck cannot suffer fatigue.
units.practice: 鋼橋面焊接程序評定應包含熔深與焊趾形狀要求，並在製造廠建立首件檢查與定期切片制度；交接時提供鋪面材料、交通量假設與疲勞熱點清單，供營運單位規劃檢查週期。~Welding procedure qualification for the steel deck should include penetration and toe-profile requirements, with first-article inspection and periodic macro-sections at the fabricator; at handover supply the surfacing materials, traffic assumptions and a fatigue hot-spot list so the operator can plan inspection intervals.

units.anchor: 主跨伸縮縫行程~Main-span joint travel
units.title: 伸縮縫行程與營運交接~Expansion-joint travel and operational handover
units.mechanism: 超長跨懸索橋的橋面在溫度、活載、風與地震下會沿縱向移動，伸縮縫與支承要容納這些位移而不卡死。公開資料顯示本橋伸縮縫由 MAURER 供應。除了最大行程，長期累積的滑移距離與速度決定滑動元件與密封的磨耗；車流越大，交通引起的微小往復位移越多。營運單位交接時必須取得設計行程、預設位置與溫度的關係，以及監測位移的基準，才能判斷日後的位移是正常溫度反應還是異常。~The deck of a super-long suspension bridge moves longitudinally under temperature, live load, wind and earthquake, and expansion joints and bearings must absorb this without locking. Public records show the expansion joints were supplied by MAURER. Beyond maximum travel, long-term accumulated sliding distance and speed govern wear of sliding elements and seals; heavier traffic means more small reciprocating movements. At handover the operator must receive the design travel, the relationship between preset position and temperature, and a baseline for monitored displacement, to judge whether later movement is a normal thermal response or an anomaly.
units.model: 溫度位移 ΔL = α·L·ΔT。設固定點位於跨中、半跨 L = 1,011.5 m、α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C、溫差 60 °C：ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,011.5×60 ≈ 0.73 m。若再加上活載與風造成的縱向位移約 0.5 m，單側伸縮縫需求約 1.2 m 以上。數值為教學假設。~Thermal movement ΔL = α·L·ΔT. With the fixed point at mid-span, a half-span L = 1,011.5 m, α = 1.2×10⁻⁵ /°C and a 60 °C range: ΔL = 1.2×10⁻⁵×1,011.5×60 ≈ 0.73 m. Adding about 0.5 m of longitudinal movement from live load and wind, each joint needs more than about 1.2 m of travel. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 安裝時依當日橋面溫度設定伸縮縫預設開口，並記錄溫度與開口；營運期以位移計連續記錄伸縮縫開口與橋面溫度，繪出位移—溫度關係，偏離基準趨勢時檢查支承摩擦、卡阻或結構異常。~At installation set the joint opening for the day's deck temperature and record both; in service log joint opening and deck temperature continuously with displacement transducers, plotting displacement against temperature, and investigate bearing friction, binding or structural anomaly when the trend departs from the baseline.
units.failure: 伸縮縫預設位置錯誤或行程不足，極端溫度或地震時可能頂死，產生巨大縱向力傳入塔與錨碇；滑動元件磨耗未及時更換，模數式伸縮縫的中梁可能斷裂並危及行車。~A wrongly preset or undersized joint can close up in extreme temperature or an earthquake, driving large longitudinal forces into towers and anchorages; worn sliding elements left unreplaced can let a modular joint's centre beam break and endanger traffic.
units.misconception: 伸縮縫只要容納溫度位移就足夠，不必考慮交通引起的累積滑移。~An expansion joint only needs to absorb thermal movement; accumulated traffic-induced sliding does not matter.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含伸縮縫與支承的設計行程、安裝溫度與開口紀錄、累積位移監測方法、耗材更換週期與備品清單；營運單位與原設計者應約定異常位移的通報與評估流程。~Handover documents should include design travel of joints and bearings, installation temperature and opening records, the method for monitoring accumulated movement, consumable replacement intervals and spares; the operator and original designer should agree a reporting and assessment procedure for abnormal movement.

example: 設計練習：主跨 l = 2,023 m，每條主纜承受恆載 w = 137.3 kN/m（兩纜合計 28 t/m），主纜鋼絲面積 A = 0.4749 m²，鋼絲強度 1,960 MPa。方案甲垂跨比 1/8.5：f = 238.0 m，H = w·l²/(8f) = 137.3×2,023²/(8×238.0) ≈ 295 MN，塔頂張力 T = H·√(1+16n²) ≈ 295×1.105 ≈ 326 MN，應力 326/0.4749 ≈ 687 MPa，恆載安全係數約 2.85，塔高約 317 m。方案乙垂跨比 1/10：f = 202.3 m，H ≈ 347 MN，T ≈ 374 MN，應力約 788 MPa，係數約 2.49，塔高約 281 m。降低塔高約 36 m 的代價是主纜張力增加約 15%，若要維持相同安全係數，鋼絲面積須增加約 15%，自重再推高張力。數值為教學假設，不代表 1915 恰納卡萊大橋的設計計算。~Design exercise: main span l = 2,023 m, dead load per cable w = 137.3 kN/m (28 t/m for both cables), wire area per cable A = 0.4749 m², wire strength 1,960 MPa. Option A, sag ratio 1/8.5: f = 238.0 m, H = w·l²/(8f) = 137.3×2,023²/(8×238.0) ≈ 295 MN, tower-top tension T = H·√(1+16n²) ≈ 295×1.105 ≈ 326 MN, stress 326/0.4749 ≈ 687 MPa, dead-load safety factor about 2.85, tower about 317 m. Option B, sag ratio 1/10: f = 202.3 m, H ≈ 347 MN, T ≈ 374 MN, stress about 788 MPa, factor about 2.49, tower about 281 m. Cutting about 36 m of tower height costs about 15% more cable tension; keeping the same safety factor needs about 15% more wire, whose weight pushes tension up again. Values are teaching assumptions, not the design calculations of the 1915 Çanakkale Bridge.
history: 土耳其公路總局把達達尼爾海峽跨越列為馬爾馬拉高速公路環線的關鍵段，2017 年 3 月 18 日動土，由 DL E&C、Limak、SK ecoplant 與 Yapı Merkezi 組成的聯合體承建，COWI 負責細部設計，Arup 與 Aas-Jakobsen 等擔任獨立驗證。工程以 1,960 MPa 級鋼絲、318 m 鋼塔與乾塢預製沉箱完成，2022 年 3 月 18 日通車，以 2,023 m 超越明石海峽大橋成為世界最長跨徑懸索橋，也是第一座主跨超過 2 km 的懸索橋。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Türkiye's General Directorate of Highways made the Dardanelles crossing the key link of the Marmara motorway ring; ground was broken on 18 March 2017, with a consortium of DL E&C, Limak, SK ecoplant and Yapı Merkezi as contractor, COWI as detailed designer, and Arup and Aas-Jakobsen among the independent checkers. Built with 1,960 MPa class wire, 318 m steel towers and caissons cast in dry dock, it opened on 18 March 2022, overtaking Akashi Kaikyo with a 2,023 m span to become the world's longest suspension span and the first beyond 2 km. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: 跨徑配置 770 m + 2,023 m + 770 m，懸索橋段長 3,563 m，含引橋全長 4,608 m~Span layout 770 m + 2,023 m + 770 m; suspension bridge 3,563 m long, 4,608 m including approach viaducts
鋼塔高 318 m，含頂部裝飾為 334 m~Steel towers 318 m tall, 334 m including the finials
垂直航行淨空 70 m、水平航行淨空 1,600 m~Vertical navigation clearance 70 m and horizontal clearance 1,600 m
主纜鋼絲抗拉強度 1,960 MPa 級~Main-cable wire strength in the 1,960 MPa class
主跨每條主纜 144 股、每股 127 根 5.75 mm 鋼絲（邊跨 148 股）~Each main-span cable has 144 strands of 127 wires of 5.75 mm (148 strands in the side spans)
鋼箱梁寬約 45 m、最大深度約 3.5 m，橫梁間距約 24 m~Steel deck about 45 m wide and up to about 3.5 m deep, with cross-beams about 24 m apart
主跨共 87 個橋面節塊，2021 年 11 月 13 日全部吊裝完成~87 deck blocks in total, all lifted by 13 November 2021
